Taxi driver defrauds French tourists in Agra; police recover money

Two French women tourists were allegedly defrauded of 50 euros by a taxi driver in Agra. The tourists reported the incident to the tourism police, who intervened and facilitated the return of the money. The incident occurred while the tourists were visiting the Taj Mahal area.
